summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K solely to incorporate an underwriting agreement into its existing Form F-3ASR shelf registration. The agreement covers a $1.25 billion tranche of 5.511% senior callable fixed-to-fixed notes due 2030 and a $1.5 billion tranche of 5.715% senior callable notes due 2032, priced under a November 4, 2026 pricing agreement. Barclays, BMO, Lloyds Securities, Mizuho, Morgan Stanley and Scotia act as representatives. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation; no equity, stake, premium or deal clock is implicated.
